requirements.text: The XCP FSW shall process science data from the CCD camera and transmit it to the Spacecraft Control Unit (SCU) as CCSDS Source Packets.
The XCP FSW shall receive and execute telecommands from the SCU to control instrument state and camera modes.
The XCP FSW shall collect and transmit housekeeping telemetry to the SCU as CCSDS Source Packets.
The XCP FSW shall synchronize its local clock with the spacecraft clock using the 1PPS signal and time messages received via the 1553 interface.
The XCP FSW shall perform closed-loop control of the telescope tube heaters and baffle heaters based on temperature setpoints and hysteresis values provided by telecommand.
The XCP FSW shall perform centroid calculations on CCD image data to determine source position.
The XCP FSW shall implement the observation sequence logic, including automatic, preplanned, and target of opportunity modes.
The XCP FSW shall support multiple science data acquisition modes including Bias Calculation, Image, Photo-Diode, Windowed Timing, Photon Counting, Null, and Raw Data modes.
The XCP FSW shall monitor and report the status of CCD bias voltages, clock voltages, temperatures, and other housekeeping sensors.
The XCP FSW shall be capable of processing and transmitting science telemetry at rates up to 100kbps during high-flux events.
The XCP FSW shall perform centroiding and transmit position messages to the UVOT and TDRSS within 5 seconds of target acquisition for typical bursts.
The XCP FSW shall perform Built-In Tests (BIT) during the boot process to verify system integrity.
The XCP FSW shall implement a watchdog timer mechanism to trigger a system reset in the event of software failure.
The XCP FSW shall reject non-RED commands while in the RED state.
The XCP FSW shall support the loading of up to 64 distinct sequencer programs for CCD waveform generation.
